name: CK IN2U for Her
notes: Fragrantica page read directly in a browser (WebFetch returned 403). Parfumo has the same pyramid except the base lists 'Ambergris' where Fragrantica lists 'Amber'. Fragrantica gives no concentration; Nice One sells it as Eau de Toilette 100ml. Parfumo says production was apparently discontinued. Fragrantica shows 8 accords; the first 6 are given. Perfumers per Fragrantica: Bruno Jovanovic, Jean-Marc Chaillan, Loc Dong, Carlos Benaim.

name: Beauty
notes: Fragrantica, Parfumo (Ambrette / Jasmine / Cedarwood) and Perfume Direct (Ambrette Seeds / Jasmine / Cedar) agree on a three-note pyramid. DISAGREEMENT: The Perfume Shop lists a longer pyramid: top Citrus cocktail, Orange blossom; heart Jasmine, Neo-lily; base Cedarwood, Ambrette seeds (ambrette moves to the base). Fragrantica shows only 5 accords. The EDP is the 2010 original; Sheer Beauty (id sheerbeauty) is the later EDT edition.

name: Eternity Moment
notes: FragranceX gives the same notes as Fragrantica (melon, litchi, guava, raspberry / passion flower, peony, water lily, jasmine / sandalwood, cashmere wood, musk, Brazilian rosewood). DISAGREEMENT: Parfumo lists top Lychee, Guava, Pomegranate blossom; heart Peony, Water lily, Jasmine, Passion flower; base Musk, Raspberry, Rosewood (raspberry in the base, no melon, cashmere wood or sandalwood). A search snippet from other US retailers (Miles Kimball/Walter Drake, not read) matches the Parfumo version plus cashmere. Fragrantica's own description text also mentions pomegranate blossom, which is not in its pyramid. The Nice One concentration evidence is the product title as listed on the Nice One page read (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-ckin2u-for-women-eau-de-toilette-100ml-n5567); the product page itself (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-eternity-moment-for-women-eau-de-parfum-100ml-n956) was not opened.

name: Sheer Beauty
notes: YEAR DIFFERS FROM THE BRIEF: Fragrantica and Parfumo both give 2012, not 2011; Fragrantica says it was available from January 2012 as 30, 50 and 100 ml Eau de Toilette (a late-2011 announcement is possible but not seen). Parfumo pyramid agrees (Red berries, Bellini, Bergamot / Pink lily, Peony, Jasmine / Musk, Vanilla blossom, Sandalwood). Fragrantica spells the base note 'Vanille'. Nice One title reads 'Eau De Toilette'. The Nice One concentration evidence is the product title as listed on the Nice One page read (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-ckin2u-for-women-eau-de-toilette-100ml-n5567); the product page itself (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-sheer-beauty-for-women-eau-de-toilette-n1250) was not opened.

name: Euphoria
notes: Parfumo (Eau de Parfum, 2005) agrees: Pomegranate, Green notes, Persimmon / Black orchid, Champaca, Lotus / Mahogany wood, Amber, Black violet, Creamy notes. Fragrantica's older description paragraph names rose hip and Japanese apple, which are not in its pyramid; the pyramid was used. Many Euphoria flankers exist (Intense, Deep, Endless, EDT versions); this is the 2005 original women's EDP.

name: Musk (Jovan Musk for Women)
notes: Neither Fragrantica ('Fragrance Notes') nor Parfumo gives a pyramid; both list the same four notes (Parfumo order: Musk, Neroli, Bergamot, Jasmine). Fragrantica names it 'Musk'; Parfumo 'Musk for Women' (marketed by Coty). Fragrantica says it is sold as 25 and 60 ml Cologne Concentrate Spray, 100 ml Cologne Spray, 10 ml Musk Oil and 70 ml body spray; perfume.com lists 60 and 96 ml Cologne Concentrate Spray; Nice One's listing is titled 'Jovan Musk For Women - Cologne Spray', so check which format the catalogue item is. UNVERIFIED: a search summary (source page not identified or read) gave a pyramid with heart Spice, Lavender and base Sandalwood, Tonka Beans, and Amazon titles mention amber; neither was confirmed on a page read, so they are not used.

name: Boucheron Quatre (Quatre pour Femme)
notes: Fragrantica page name is 'Boucheron Quatre'; retailers call it 'Quatre pour Femme' EDP. Fragrantica's own description gives a different breakdown: top bitter orange, red currant, green tangerine, lemon, grapefruit; heart sambac jasmine, rose, wild strawberry, peach, apple; base golden woods, cedar, cashmere, musk, vanilla, caramel (red currant is not in its pyramid). A search snippet attributed to the brand site (fr.boucheron.com, domain no longer resolves, not read) lists head Bitter Orange, Red Currant Sparks; heart Sambac Jasmine Absolute, Rose Absolute; base Golden Woods, Musk. Parfumo cross-check not usable: the Parfumo URL /Perfumes/Boucheron/Quatre returned an unrelated 1999 unisex entry with invented note names (see summary). The Nice One concentration evidence is the product title as listed on the Nice One page read (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-ckin2u-for-women-eau-de-toilette-100ml-n5567); the product page itself (https://niceonesa.com/en/boucheron-quatre-for-women-eau-de-parfum-100ml-n779) was not opened.

name: Paradiso
notes: Fragrantica description: launched February 2015 (Coty), perfumer Louise Turner, sold as 30, 50 and 75 ml Eau de Parfum; description names the base as cypress, parasol pine and pink laurel. No independent second source read: the Parfumo page returned invented notes (see summary), so it was discarded. The Nice One concentration evidence is the product title as listed on the Nice One page read (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-ckin2u-for-women-eau-de-toilette-100ml-n5567); the product page itself (https://niceonesa.com/en/roberto-cavalli-paradiso-for-women-eau-de-parfum-n6171) was not opened.

name: Roberto Cavalli Eau de Parfum
notes: Notes agree across Fragrantica page, Fragrantica launch article (pink pepper / orange blossom / tonka bean, vanilla, benzoin) and Parfumo (Pink pepper / Orange blossom / Benzoin, Vanilla, Tonka bean). IDENTITY DOUBT on 'snake-skin bottle': no source read describes this bottle as snakeskin. Fragrantica says 'golden shades and leopard print decorate the bottle design and packaging'; its photo shows a smooth gold oval bottle with an animal-striped collar and a gold tiara stopper with the RC initials. Nice One's 'Roberto Cavalli For Women - Eau de Parfum' shows this same bottle, so the catalogue item matches the 2012 EDP. The snake motif belongs to other Cavalli bottles: the 2002 original 'Roberto Cavalli' (tall bottle with a snake coiled at the neck; notes Magnolia, Red Apple, Bergamot, Mandarin / Wild Orchid, Rosemary, Freesia, Honeysuckle / Amber, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Cedar, Musk) and Serpentine (2005). Retailers sometimes sell the 2012 EDP as 'Roberto Cavalli Signature'.

name: Paradiso Azzurro
notes: Fragrantica: perfumer Louise Turner, turquoise diamond-shaped bottle, sold as 30, 50 and 75 ml Eau de Parfum. No second pyramid source read (Parfumo skipped after it began serving invented notes). The Nice One concentration evidence is the product title as listed on the Nice One page read (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-ckin2u-for-women-eau-de-toilette-100ml-n5567); the product page itself (https://niceonesa.com/en/roberto-cavalli-paradiso-azzurro-for-women-eau-de-parfum-n6077) was not opened.

name: Guess Seductive
notes: The original is an EAU DE TOILETTE (Parfumo: 'Seductive, Guess 2010, Eau de Toilette', marketed by Interparfums, perfumer Veronique Nyberg). The 'Eau De Parfum, 75Ml' store listing is a mislabel: the Amazon.sa page titled 'GUESS Seductive For girls - Eau De Parfum, 75Ml' (ASIN B0041FXETY) states 'Fragrance concentration: Eau de Toilette' in its own specifications, ranks in Women's Eau de Toilette, and the same ASIN is sold on amazon.com as '2.5 oz 75 ml EDT Spray' (search result title). No women's Seductive EDP with different notes was found: Fragrantica's Guess designer list has only the 2010 original plus flankers (I'm Yours, Wild Summer, Sunkissed, Noir Women, Charm, Flirt, Kiss, Red, Blue, Dream, Desire Women), and Parfumo's Guess list shows only the EDT and a Fragrance Mist for the original. Parfumo pyramid agrees (Blackcurrant, Bergamot, Pear / Jasmine, Orange blossom, Iris / Cashmere wood, Vanilla, Frankincense); the Amazon.sa description gives the same notes.
